name: gridly
description: Run your WooCommerce store from a conversation: sales, orders and stock answers, plus safe bulk changes with preview and undo.

interface.longDescription: Gridly connects ChatGPT to your WooCommerce store, so a shop owner can manage the shop by asking questions. Ask about your WooCommerce store in plain English: how sales did, which orders are stuck, what is running low, which customers have gone quiet. Gridly can also make changes — bulk price edits, new product text, order updates and discount codes — but always shows a preview first and only acts after you approve. Every change is numbered and can be undone, and you can schedule a change for later. Connect your store in a minute by approving access on your own WordPress screen; no plugin to install. Gridly does not store your orders, products or customers, and store keys are encrypted.
defaultPrompt: How did my shop do last week compared to the week before?
What's running low on stock right now?
Give me promotion ideas based on my recent sales.
